purpose: Determine before any selected-block RESULT whether the prospective 400m-to-333m design has repeated same-rider support, without estimating affinity or selecting riders from outcomes.

nara.important_limit: Nara final racecard may change because this is an assignment/scheduled roster. Every repeated-rider candidate remains pending until the final PRE racecard is published.

interpretation.support_conclusion: The prospective design has non-zero same-rider cross-circumference support before outcomes. Nine Takeo 400m actual Day1 S-grade riders are independently present on the future Nara 333.33m scheduled G3 roster.
interpretation.not_a_result: This is support/transport evidence only. It does not show that circumference affinity exists, its sign, or its predictive value.
interpretation.selection_bias_guard: The nine names are the exhaustive intersection of the frozen Takeo actual Day1 S-grade roster with the already-preselected future Nara scheduled roster; they were not selected by performance or outcome.

profile_attribute_firewall: Current KEIRIN.JP preference/home-bank/current score/class/style fields are not admitted as historical or predictive features by this artifact. Registration number is identity-only.
next_gates: Re-check Nara final PRE racecard before its cutoff and retain withdrawals/non-assignments as explicit support failures.
Complete additional cross-block roster intersections for other preselected 333m/400m venues where PRE rosters become available.
Do not open predictive RESULT until source, identity, support, fit/eval allocation and low-DOF predictive gate are separately frozen.
